prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1154; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster speaking. The call is being recorded with your permission. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving my sedan. I had a green light going through the intersection.

Q: Can you describe what happened?

A: I was about halfway across when a pickup coming from my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact spun me partway around. I didn't see him until the last second, so I couldn't brake in time.

Q: Did you notice any traffic signal changes before the impact?

A: My light was green the whole time I was approaching. I'm pretty sure of that.

Q: Were there any other vehicles or witnesses nearby?

A: A car was stopped at the far corner, but I don't know if they saw anything. I didn't get any names.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment after the collision?

A: Yes. Paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to the emergency room. They told me I fractured my left wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I'm waiting to see a specialist.

Q: Are you able to work or perform normal daily activities at the moment?

A: Not really. I'm right-handed and I can't grip or lift much with the left, so it's slowed down everything at home.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. Thanks.
